The Chinese characters for Freya

As a transliteration, Freya is usually written 弗雷娅 (Fú léi yà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

弗
Fú
not
雷
léi
thunder
娅
yà
aunt by marriage (in names)

Origin and meaning

With Norse origins, Freya is usually read as “lady, goddess of love”.

About the name Freya

Freya was the Norse goddess of love, beauty and war.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Freya suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
